run_HDR_merge_pipeline: run the HDR merge pipeline for a dataset by merging bracketed exposures into HDR images
run_merge_with_capture_deletion: run the HDR merge pipeline and delete capture folders after merge completes
run_hdrmerge_for_folders: run hdrmerge.py on folders 40 through 53 using Rec2020 color space and R-PPNE merge method
rename_merged_images: run rename_images.py to rename all merged HDR images with a specified prefix path
validate_required_env_vars: validate that DATASETS_PATH HDR_REPO_PATH CAPTURE_DIR DCRAW_EMU_PATH and TRANSFER_EXE environment variables are set
